name: Telier
description: An old hermit who finally understands magic by giving himself to a tree dryad.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Telier finally understands magic and is embraced by a dryad tree, disappearing.
timeline.quote: He finally understands that he has to give himself fully over to the mana to be able to use magic.
